Name: Spouse Room Free Decoration
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Allows spouses to decorate their rooms as they wish.
You can freely re-cover the walls and floor.
There is also a setting to display default furniture, walls and floors.

[size=4][color=#00ffff]Note.[/color][/size]
Not compatible with Farmhouse Map Mod which changes the location of the spouse's room.
Adding that compatibility is not difficult, so feel free to request it on the POSTS page.
It would help others if you could report other FarmhouseMods that are compatible by default.
Please report this also on the POSTS page.

[quote][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Important Notes:[/b][/size][/color]
Changing this mod's settings while the player is inside the Farmhouse may cause some visual issues. If this happens, leave the Farmhouse and enter again, or sleep until the next day, and the display should return to normal. If you are concerned about this, please change the settings from the title screen.[/quote]
[color=#ffff00][size=4]When using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10029]CSR[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PSR[/url].[/size][/color]
When using CSR/PSR, the default floors and walls are now displayed. Due to the current CSR/PSR implementation, it is difficult for other Content Patcher mods to configure floors and walls individually. Therefore, when using CSR/PSR, this mod mainly provides furniture removal and options to hide parrots and frogs.
